title: S-92 Quick Reference
intro: For training use only. This is an informal quick reference of selected S-92 RFM limitations, speeds and key system values. Always use the official RFM as primary reference.

groups.title: Propulsion & Drive Limits — Dual Engine (Q% / TGT °C / Ng % / Np %)

items.label: Max continuous
lines: Torque: 100%
TGT: 935 °C

items.label: 30 min (hover only)
lines: Torque: 100%
TGT: 988 °C

items.label: Takeoff (5 min)
lines: Torque: 100%
TGT: 995 °C

items.label: Transient
lines: 10 s: Torque 120%

items.label: Notes
lines: 86% Q above 100 KIAS is a flight-control-load limit, not a gearbox limit.
One engine may exceed 100% up to 110% provided the other is proportionally less and the sum ≤ 200%.
Np overspeed trip: 120%. Ng overspeed trip: 108.5%.

groups.title: Propulsion & Drive Limits — Single Engine / OEI (Q% / TGT °C / Ng % / Np %)

items.label: Max continuous
lines: Torque: 120%
TGT: 988 °C

items.label: OEI 2 min
lines: Torque: 120%
TGT: 1006 °C

items.label: OEI 30 sec
lines: Torque: 141%
TGT: 1049 °C

items.label: Transient 5 sec / Max starting peak
lines: Torque: 156%
TGT (max starting peak): 1000 °C

items.label: Avoid prolonged operation
lines: 36% to 49% — tail rotor drive shaft critical range
56% to 67% — engine power turbine critical range

items.label: General
lines: VNE power on (max airspeed): 165 KIAS
VNE power off: 120 KIAS (or lower VNE power-on value if below 120 KIAS)
Vmini (IFR): 50 KIAS
Max with landing gear down/in transit: 165 KIAS
Max with APU operating: 150 KIAS

items.label: Degraded configurations (all): 120 KIAS max
lines: One engine inoperative
One or both SAS inoperative
Both APs inoperative
One primary flight control servo inoperative
Hydraulic boost inoperative
Any sliding door/window pinned open

items.label: Ground / low-speed
lines: Max groundspeed normal takeoff/landing: 50 kt (Temporary Revision No. 3); after landing above 50 kt, no further flight or towing (taxi permitted)
Max groundspeed taxi: 35 kt
Max groundspeed brake application: 35 kt
Max sideward flight / crosswind hover: 35 kt
Max rearward flight / tailwind hover: 35 kt

items.label: Other
lines: Max for landing gear emergency blowdown: 90 KIAS
Max for opening/closing sliding door or window: 80 KIAS
Max standard wiper operation: 40 kt; improved wiper: 100 KIAS

items.label: General
lines: Enroute: 15,000 ft density altitude
Cat A ground level helipad: 5,500 ft density altitude or 6,000 ft pressure altitude, whichever is lower
Icing flight (RIPS on): up to 10,000 ft pressure altitude

items.label: Coupled operations
lines: Above 120 KIAS: min 200 ft AGL
At or below 120 KIAS: min 50 ft AGL (monitor controls below 200 ft; VMC required below 100 ft)

items.label: Weight
lines: Max takeoff and landing weight: 12,020 kg (26,500 lb)
Min operating weight: 7,348 kg (16,200 lb)

items.label: Loading
lines: Max cabin floor loading: 366 kg/m² (75 lb/ft²); heavy-duty floor: 976 kg/m² (200 lb/ft²)
Max combined baggage/ramp load: 454 kg (1,000 lb); max shelf load: 136 kg (300 lb)
Fuel imbalance above 317 kg (700 lb) combined with unbalanced cargo may exceed lateral CG limits

items.label: Ambient temperature
lines: Operating range: -40 °C to ISA +35 °C
Engines shut down below -25 °C ground OAT for over 1 hr: warm to 0 °C for 8 hr, or use Cold Weather Pre-heat kit before flight
Pitot heat / engine anti-ice ON below +5 °C OAT

items.label: Crosswind & slope
lines: Cat A horizontal takeoff/landing: max 35 kt crosswind
Cat A ground level helipad: max 22 kt crosswind
Slope landing: 10° nose up/down slope, 13° left/right side up-slope

items.label: Prohibited
lines: Aerobatic maneuvers
Practice touchdown autorotations
360° hovering turns in less than 12 seconds
Flight in freezing drizzle/rain or supercooled large drops (SLD)
Use of OEI power ratings except for an actual engine failure

items.label: Other
lines: Max bank angle, one primary flight control servo inoperative: 30°
Low fuel light(s) illuminated: avoid pitch >10° nose up or >5° nose down
Fuel crossfeed: Cat A emergency operation only; Cat B cruise flight only

items.label: Pressure
lines: Min idle: 20–30 psi
Continuous: 30–100 psi
Maximum (5 min): 100–120 psi
Max fluctuation: 5 psi

items.label: Temperature
lines: Max continuous: 132 °C
Maximum allowable: 149 °C

items.label: Back-to-back starting
lines: OAT above +15 °C: 2 starts, 5 min cooling, 2 starts, 30 min cooling, then repeat
OAT +15 °C or less: 4 starts, 15 min cooling, 4 starts, 30 min cooling, then repeat

items.label: Fuel temperature (Jet A / A-1 / JP-5 / JP-8)
lines: Anti-icing additive required below -20 °C

items.label: Cat A horizontal takeoff
lines: TDP 30–48 KIAS (1 kt steps); Vtoss = TDP + 15 kt
Accelerate at hover Q + 10%; OEI climb at Vtoss, 100% Nr, gear up with positive rate
Crosswind > 20 kt: minimum TDP 45 KIAS, add 500 ft to RTO/CTO distance

items.label: Cat A horizontal landing
lines: LDP 50 KIAS / 200 ft AGL, 600 fpm; flare at 50 ft and 50 KIAS
Balked: accelerate to 70 KIAS (35 ft minimum), climb at 70 KIAS / 100% Nr
Crosswind > 20 kt: add 650 ft to landing distance

items.label: Cat A ground level helipad takeoff
lines: Vertical climb to TDP at 850–1150 fpm; minimum TDP 30 ft
Maximum gross weight 24,500 lb; minimum field length 600 ft
Night: maximum TDP is the lower of 110 ft and the maximum reject TDP

items.label: Cat A ground level helipad landing
lines: 35 KIAS, 500 fpm to the flare at 50 ft (about 8.1°)
Minimum LDP 125 ft if no obstacles over 10 ft in the balked landing path
Balked: accelerate to Vblss 55 KIAS, 2 min OEI power, then Vbroc

items.label: Category B
lines: Takeoff: hover Q + up to 10% at 10 ft, rotate at 45 KIAS, climb at Vy
Anti-ice on: add 320 ft to Cat B takeoff distance
Landing: 600 fpm at 50 KIAS through 200 ft; flare at 50 ft and 50 KIAS

items.label: Wind accountability
lines: Credit no more than 50% of the headwind benefit
Apply 150% of the tailwind penalty

items.label: Vy (best rate of climb)
lines: 80 KIAS at sea level, −1 kt per 1000 ft

items.label: OEI climb rotor speed
lines: Cat A climbout: 100% Nr from TDP to Vy (80 KIAS)
Single engine above Vy: 105% Nr

items.label: Autorotation
lines: Glide 80–100 KIAS, Nr 105%; minimum flare airspeed 85 KIAS
Minimum descent 2,200–2,400 fpm at 80 KIAS
Maximum glide 0.6 NM per 1000 ft at 100 KIAS

items.label: AFCS bucket speed
lines: 80 KIAS at sea level, −1 kt per 1000 ft

items.label: Hydraulics
lines: Normal 3,500–4,200 psi
HYD 1/2 PUMP FAIL: below 1,900–2,050 psi
HYD 3 PUMP FAIL: below 500 psi (depress) / 2,000 psi (high mode)
SAS 1/2 PRES: below 1,100 psi
TEMP ALERT above 110 °C; TEMP LIMIT above 135 °C

items.label: Fuel
lines: FUEL 1/2 LOW: 215 ± 45 lb (98 ± 20 kg) in that tank
With FUEL LOW: avoid pitch above 10° nose up or below 5° nose down

items.label: Engine
lines: IDLE: Ng approximately 67%
FADEC declares engine failure below 55% Ng
Start: throttle to IDLE when TGT is below 150 °C
Post-shutdown fire: TGT 540 °C or higher

items.label: Electrical
lines: BATT HOT: battery above 70 °C (158 °F)
SE landing: Nr below 96% can drop both AC generators offline
